subject.title: refactor: finish retained plugin SDK demotions

question: Should OpenClaw remove these five public plugin SDK paths now, or preserve them until the named separately published plugins migrate and the replacement window has elapsed?
rationale: This is a public SDK removal with known external imports; tests in this repository cannot determine the intended upgrade contract or acceptable breakage window.

options.title: Keep exports and migrate consumers
options.body: Retain the public paths, migrate and release all known external plugins, and remove them only after the documented compatibility window.

options.title: Approve a breaking removal
options.body: Remove the paths now and explicitly accept that existing external plugin installations must upgrade or will fail to load.

options.title: Pause these demotions
options.body: Leave the records pending until a capability-complete replacement and consumer migration audit are available.

recommendation.title: Keep exports and migrate consumers
recommendation.body: Retain the public paths, migrate and release all known external plugins, and remove them only after the documented compatibility window.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the prior merged sweep that retained these records and the present follow-up that proposes their removal.
